restated: An adversary who has compromised Windows hosts on this network stole credentials from those hosts.
what_would_confirm: Observable evidence such as process access to lsass.exe, LSASS memory dumps, SAM/SECURITY/NTDS.dit registry hive extraction, credential-dumping tool execution, or subsequent authentication with stolen credentials.
what_would_refute: Observable absence of LSASS access, credential-dump files, SAM/SECURITY/NTDS.dit reads or exfiltration, credential-dumping tool execution, and no evidence of stolen credentials used elsewhere.
